summary: @or-sdk/tags preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling bundle
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style _0xNNNN identifier maps and, on install, downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-cjs bundle whose entire body is a shuffled string array plus a shift-decoder (`WV8StW`) — the standard obfuscator.io fingerprint — with no source or source map shipped. The package advertises itself as a tags SDK and has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime or a large opaque payload at install time. Bringing in Bun specifically to execute the obfuscated bundle bypasses Node-based static analysis of the package's own JS graph. The obfuscated bytes execute automatically on `npm install` via the preinstall lifecycle hook.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
